name: flobehejohn-portfolio
description: Projet web pour le portfolio interactif et design optimisé.
author: Flobehejohn

scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.js playwright.config.ts scripts/**/*.mjs tests/**/*.ts assets/ts/**/*.ts assets/js/analytics.js assets/js/usage-signals.js --max-warnings=0
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run audit:seo && npm run audit:build && npm run audit:analytics && npm run audit:content && npm run audit:security && npm run audit:architecture-owners
scripts.test:audio-runtime: playwright test tests/legacy-audio-runtime.spec.ts tests/audio-pjax-resume-contract.spec.ts --workers=1 --timeout=120000 --output=test-results/audio-online && node scripts/ci/write-runtime-proof.mjs audio-online
scripts.test:audio-r2-runtime: playwright test tests/audio-r2-contract.spec.ts --workers=1 --timeout=120000 --output=test-results/audio-r2 && node scripts/ci/write-runtime-proof.mjs audio-r2-runtime
scripts.test:pjax-runtime: playwright test tests/pjax-navigation-contract.spec.ts tests/isotope-pjax-runtime.spec.ts --workers=1 --timeout=120000 --output=test-results/pjax && node scripts/ci/write-runtime-proof.mjs pjax-runtime
scripts.test:interactive-runtime: playwright test tests/interactive-modules.contract.spec.ts tests/musicam-runtime.spec.ts tests/synth-runtime.spec.ts tests/magic-cloud-runtime.spec.ts --workers=1 --timeout=120000 --output=test-results/interactive && node scripts/ci/write-runtime-proof.mjs interactive-runtime
scripts.test:site-matrix: playwright test tests/site-matrix.spec.ts && node scripts/ci/write-runtime-proof.mjs site-matrix
scripts.test:security: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium && playwright test tests/security-baseline.spec.ts
scripts.test:audio-modal: playwright test tests/audio-modal-toggle-contract.spec.ts --workers=1 --timeout=120000 --output=test-results/audio-modal && node scripts/ci/write-runtime-proof.mjs audio-modal
